headlines.title: 황기연 수은 행장 “ 다음 50년도 수출강국 버팀목될 것 ”
headlines.summary: 한국수출입은행 설립 50주년 기념식 AI·반도체 등 전략산업 금융지원 확대 “수출 1조달러 시대 정책금융 중심축” [한국수출입은행 제공] 황기연(사진) 수출입은행장이 은행 설립 50주년을 맞아 “다음 50년에도 대한민국 경제의 든든한 버팀목이 되겠다”고 강조했다.

headlines.title: 한국 月수출 1000억달러 첫 돌파 …獨·中·美 이은 4번째 기록
headlines.summary: 반도체 호황 힙입어 6월 1022억달러 수출 22일 관세청에 따르면 이달 1일부터 20일까지 수출은 620억 달러로 지난해 동기 대비 60.4% 증가해 동기간 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. 같은 기간 수입도 445억달러로 23.2% 늘었으며 무역수지는 175억 달러 흑자를 기록했다. 이날 인천 연수구 인천신항 컨테이너 터미널에 컨테이너가 쌓여 있다.

headlines.title: ‘월1000억弗’ 수출에도 기쁘지 않은 이유…‘ 1500원대 고환율 ’, 디커...
headlines.summary: ■ 수출액 1023억달러 ‘세계 4강’ 6월 전년 동기대비 70.9% 올라 호황지속땐 ‘年 1조달러’ 새역사 반도체도 월 400억달러 첫 돌파 무역 흑자는 300억달러 넘어서 한국의 6월 수출액이 1023억 달러를 기록하면서 ‘월 수출액 1000억 달러 시대’를 열었다.

headlines.title: “ 전고점 1560원 돌파가 분수령 …환율, 중장기로는 완만한 하락”
headlines.summary: 상반기 환율 결산·전문가 하반기 전망 6월 누적 평균 1484.6원…외환위기 맞먹어 전문가 “연말께 떨어질것”…시점은 ‘온도차’ 상반기 평균 원/달러 환율이 외환위기 수준에 맞먹는 1484.6원으로 집계됐다. 이란전쟁에 이어 외국인 국내 주식 순매도, 미국 금리 인상 우려 등 연이은 악재가 원화 가치 하락을 부추긴 결과다.

headlines.title: [Why&Next]"6월 평균 1528원"…연말 환율 ' 1430원 vs 1530원 ', 핵심 변수는
headlines.summary: 월·분기·반기 평균 환율, 외환위기 이후 최고 1일 역시 상승하며 1560원 선 위협 하반기, 강달러·엔화 약세 추이 주목 외국인 리밸런싱·자본유출 기조·심리 등 관건 지난달 원·달러 환율 평균이 1530원에 근접하면서 1998년 외환위기 이후 최고치를 기록했다. 2분기(4~6월) 평균 역시 1500원을 넘어섰다.

headlines.title: "韓경제 올해 4% 성장" 전망 나와… 반도체 호황에 일제히 상향 조정
headlines.summary: 국내외 기관 10여 곳 3%대 전망 반도체 경기가 예상보다 더 강한 호조세를 띠면서 올해 우리나라 경제성장률이 4%에 달할 것이라는 전망이 나왔다. 1일 금융권에 따르면 영국 캐피털 이코노믹스(CE)는 최근 보고서에서 우리나라의 올해 실질 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률 전망치를 4.0%로 제시했다. 이 기관은 지난 2월 1.0%에서 3월 1.6%, 4월 2.

headlines.title: SK, 메가프로젝트 전력 셀프공급 … 10GW 신재생에너지기업 세운다
headlines.summary: 연말 통합법인 ‘홀드코’ 출범 2031년까지 원전 10기 규모 SK가 세계 최대 사모펀드 그룹인 콜버그크래비스로버츠(KKR)와 손잡고 올해 말 국내 최대 규모 신재생에너지 기업을 출범한다.

headlines.title: 반도체만 잔치 , 석화·철강‘신음’… K굴뚝 식어간다
headlines.summary: ■ “이러다간 10년 내 반도체 빼고 중국에 다 넘어가” 여수·포항 상가공실 등 지역경제 휘청 “반도체처럼 챙겨달라” 울상 정부 관계자 ‘차이나 리스크’ 경고 “한국, 중국 보다 나은 건 반도체 뿐” 김성훈·신병남 기자, 포항=박천학·여수=김대우 기자 “지역 전통산업의 근간이 휘청거리는데 경기는 오죽하겠습니까.

headlines.summary: 핵심광물·이차전지·물류 분야 선정…누적 216개사로 확대 공급망안정화기금 우대 지원…대출 한도 확대·금리 혜택 "공급망 핵심기업 지속 발굴…대외 충격 대응 역량 강화" [카비마스=AP/뉴시스] 2026년 1월 7일(현지시간) 베네수엘라 카비마스에 사용되지 않는 원유 펌프잭이 서 있는 모습. 2026.06.02.

key_headlines.title: 2026 Economic Growth Forecast Raised to 4% on Semiconductor Strength
key_headlines.summary: Multiple domestic and international institutions have upwardly revised Korea's 2026 economic growth forecast to around 4%, driven by stronger-than-expected semiconductor industry performance.

key_headlines.title: High-Leverage KOSPI Futures Products Proliferate on Overseas Exchanges
key_headlines.summary: Overseas cryptocurrency exchanges are launching ultra-high-risk derivative products offering up to 150x leverage on KOSPI index, with regulatory authorities lacking jurisdiction over these instruments.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economy is experiencing a semiconductor-led boom with June exports breaking through the $100 billion monthly threshold and growth forecasts being revised upward to 4% for 2026. However, this success is creating a two-speed economy where traditional industries like petrochemicals and steel are languishing, raising concerns about structural economic imbalances and overreliance on semiconductor performance. Regional economies in traditional industrial hubs like Yeongsu and Pohang are showing signs of weakness, with businesses calling for government support comparable to what the semiconductor industry receives. The strong export performance is tempered by a high won-to-dollar exchange rate above 1,550 won, which benefits exporters but creates economic uncertainties.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Japan is shifting toward expansionary fiscal policy starting in 2027, targeting 3% nominal GDP growth and 1% real growth, reflecting efforts to break free from economic stagnation amid yen weakness concerns. South Korea's economic growth rate has improved dramatically, with Gyeongnam province raising its growth ranking from the lowest to the fourth nationwide through strategic policy implementation. The Federal Reserve, under new Chair Kevin Wash, is maintaining a hawkish stance on inflation despite political pressure, maintaining rates at 3.50-3.75% and signaling potential rate increases later in the year. Long-term interest rates are rising due to inflation and fiscal expansion concerns, with the 10-year government bond term premium reaching 3-year highs and impacting mortgage rates.
sections.Financial Markets: KOSPI closed at 8,476.48 points with a 0.97% gain, while KOSDAQ performed better on its anniversary, reflecting the continued strength of semiconductor stocks. The won-dollar exchange rate remains elevated near 1,550 won, approaching 1,560 won intraday as investors react to monetary policy uncertainty. Ultra-high-leverage derivative products offering up to 150x KOSPI leverage are being launched on overseas exchanges without regulatory restrictions, attracting significant capital flows despite extreme risk. Despite broader economic concerns including rising interest rates and inflation risks, semiconductor stocks and AI-related investments continue to drive market gains.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung SDI expects a turnaround in 2026 results driven by major energy storage system (ESS) project wins and supply contracts with global premium electric vehicle manufacturers. Koolon Industries has selected IMM Private Equity as the preferred bidder for its semiconductor and display materials business division, signaling consolidation in the materials sector. Hyundai Motor is adding energy to its ESG material issues while focusing on electrification, AI, and software-defined vehicles, with 960,000 electrified vehicles sold last year. The semiconductor and AI sectors continue to drive industrial growth, while traditional manufacturing faces headwinds from rising costs and global economic uncertainty.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul is easing restrictions on floor-area ratio and non-residential uses in five redevelopment promotion district zones, including areas in Yangcheon and Seongbuk districts, to expand housing supply. High-profile apartment projects like 'Refine Artia' are achieving strong pre-sales despite premium pricing concerns, with competition ratios reaching 16.52-to-1, reflecting limited new apartment supply in Seoul. The Bank of Korea warns that residential property market downturns pose greater risks to corporate lending than household lending, as construction and real estate companies could face higher delinquency rates. Yeouido's Jinju Apartment complex is preparing for reconstruction as a 57-story, 602-unit development, leveraging high floor-area ratios in commercial zones.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected President Trump's attempt to dismiss Federal Reserve Board member Lisa Cook, protecting the Fed's institutional independence despite broad presidential removal authority. American chipmakers achieved double-digit revenue growth in the first half of 2026 despite geopolitical risks, benefiting from AI investment demand and semiconductor market strength. Fed officials, including President Barkin, have warned that current inflation remains too high, with nine of 18 FOMC voting members expecting rate increases by year-end. Biotech stocks are reaching record highs globally, with expectations that Korean biotech companies will follow, supported by positive monetary and economic momentum.
sections.AI & Economy: SCD is expanding into India's air conditioning parts market, establishing local production capacity with partner FOCUSTEK to capture the market's expected 50%+ annual growth fueled by rising middle-class consumption. The Ministry of Employment and Labor is establishing forums to develop employment stability measures in response to AI-driven labor market changes and worker displacement risks. The Bank of England is developing tailored AI regulations to address cyber security threats from AI models, recognizing the need for sector-specific regulatory frameworks. Economists are debating whether AI represents genuine transformative value or a speculative bubble, with Stanford's Erik Brynjolfsson arguing AI's productivity benefits are underestimated while others urge caution.
sections.Others: Schneider Electric is acquiring Norwegian industrial AI platform provider Cognite for $3.1 billion, reflecting major investment in industrial automation and AI solutions. Bitcoin has surpassed $90 million amid capital flows driven by AI investment enthusiasm, though concerns about Fed policy tightening are creating headwinds. Tesla has raised vehicle prices by approximately 7 million won following government incentive approvals, raising questions about government subsidies effectively increasing corporate profit margins. Korean investors Securities has launched its first growth-type IMA product with a 120 billion won fundraising cap, offering semiconductor and blue-chip stock incentives for different investment tiers. Government employees' unions are demanding 7.1% wage increases citing disparity with semiconductor company performance bonuses, as national tax revenue surged 18.7% year-on-year in May.
